name: nyamuru-voice-v0.2-augmented-grouped
selection_metric: dev macro_f1 over all 19 labels with zero division=0; all 19 labels have support
selection: Best dev epoch per trial, then shared learning rate by mean best-dev macro_f1 over the three seeds. Ties: lower dev loss, earlier epoch, earlier learning-rate order. Save and evaluate every selected seed.
split_limitation: All 19 labels have train/dev/test support. Original groups and reviewed close-paraphrase families are indivisible. Holdout examples are author-generated synthetic utterances, not independent real-user or ASR validation.
adoption: No automatic production adoption or application dispatch.
source_review: Original 316 rows preserved exactly; 608 additional Codex synthetic variations author-reviewed and cross-reviewed, individual user review pending. No model inference or training before freezing the split.
